description: Give one account the same access they already have on a specific instance (by id or exact name) on other servers the user owns. The permissions copied are whatever is currently stored on the source instance. Servers the account already has access to are skipped and reported. Use list_instance_users on the source first to confirm the account and what they hold.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set this only after showing the user exactly what will be copied (the user gains the same access on each listed server) and getting their approval.

instance.description: The source instance whose access should be copied, by id or exact name.

target_instances.description: Instances to copy the access to, each by id or exact name. Each must be a server this account owns; the source itself is ignored.

user.description: Account id, or an exact username of 3+ characters to look up.

name: copy_user_access
title: Copy User Access To Other Servers
